reference.use: visual reference only (proportions: X-brace on front, 4 horizontal planks on the side, corner posts with iron studs, planked top; colour sampling). Nothing is traced or projected from it.

note: Hand-built (scripted) Blender model, no Tripo/SYNTX (registry nextStep: 'Простая ручная модель 25 uu'). All sizes are PROPOSED (04:241 'ящик (25 uu)', 17:734), not budgets. Units below: uu (= cm); the script builds in Blender metres. Blender frame: front = -Y (04 §1) -> +X in UE after UM_FBX_v1. Style B Painted Miniature (03, ART-002): large chamfers, painted wood with light worn edges, iron corner caps and studs as the only metal accent.

hidden_faces.method: BVH ray casts (max 1 m) from a barycentric sample grid (<= sample_spacing_uu) over each face, directions = upper half of a Fibonacci sphere inside the face's hemisphere (normal first); rays with a downward component count as blocked by the ground (z = 0). Hidden = no ray escapes from any sample. First run with 5 samples per face missed plank areas visible between the X braces (red in the hidden-check preview) -> grid sampling.

uv.note: Exact per-part box projection: each face onto the plane of the part-frame axis closest to its normal (unmirrored); visible stud domes one projection along the stud axis; island key (part, axis, sign, hidden) so no island mixes hidden and visible faces; hidden-only islands x0.25; pack. Smart UV (66 deg) was tried first: its averaged projection vectors gave flat plank faces anisotropy ~1.28 (p50) once they counted as visible. Packing: in-script deterministic skyline packer (>= 8 px between island boxes, >= 4 px to the edge); bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands (CONCAVE and AABB both ~47 % coverage) jittered at ~1e-6 between runs, so FBX/PNG bytes were not reproducible.

bake.ao_note: С-4: light/shadow baked into albedo moderately -> BC x (1 - 0.35 x (1 - AO)); ORM.R keeps the full AO (UE uses material AO only for indirect/sky light).

palette_srgb.note: Ref crate (lit concept) side planks median sRGB 75,68,62, front X board 84,74,67, stud highlight ~115,109,105; 03 С-5 old wood #4A3A2C-#5C4838 (74,58,44 - 92,72,56). Wood mid sits between them; low saturation for С-9 (decor cooler/muted than the game layer).

surface.note: С-3: roughness >= 0.6 on >= 90 % of the area, metallic 0 except the iron accent.

preview.note: Crate and barrel on the east tray margin (tiles end at x = 3.0 m), in the far half so the exact K-1 frame shows them; the barrel stands behind the crate (camera looks along +Y) so it does not hide the crate (03 §4.4: no vertical decor on the near side). A layout suggestion for the preview only; placement belongs to ART-009 / AD-OPEN-16.
